# Aerospace Knowledge Hub

> An independent, bilingual (EN/RU) collection of interactive "technical field
> guide" pages on spaceflight history and engineering — space stations, deep-space
> probes, Moon and Mars exploration, space telescopes, human spaceflight, and the
> physics behind it all. Every page is a single hand-authored HTML document with
> inline SVG diagrams; there is no build system and no third-party JavaScript.

Home: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/
Machine-readable index of every page: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/pages.json

## Space Stations

- [ISS & Mir](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/iss-and-mir): orbital mechanics, the ISS, and Mir.
- [Skylab & the First Stations](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/workshop-skylab): the first generation of space stations.
- [The Salyut Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/salute-salyut-program): the Soviet Salyut stations.
- [Tiangong Space Station](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/palace-tiangong-station): China's Tiangong station.
- [The Almaz Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/almaz-program-ussr): the Soviet Almaz military station program.

## Deep Space Probes

- [Voyager & Pioneer](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/voyager-and-pioner): the Pioneer and Voyager interstellar missions.
- [New Horizons & the Kuiper Belt](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/frontier-new-horizons): New Horizons, Pluto, and the Kuiper Belt.
- [Galileo at Jupiter](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/umbrella-galileo-jupiter): NASA's Galileo mission to Jupiter.
- [Cassini-Huygens at Saturn](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/finale-cassini-huygens): the Cassini-Huygens mission to Saturn and Titan.

## Moon Exploration

- [Luna & the Moon Race](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/luna-programs): the Luna program, Apollo, and the exploration of the Moon.
- [The Apollo Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/tranquility-apollo-program): the Apollo Program and the first crewed Moon landings.
- [The Clementine Mission](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/prospect-clementine-mission): the Clementine lunar mission.
- [Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/scout-lunar-reconnaissance-orbiter): NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.
- [The Chandrayaan Missions](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/valor-the-chandrayaan-mission): India's Chandrayaan lunar missions.
- [The Artemis Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/campaign-artemis-program): SLS, Orion, the Artemis Accords, and every mission from Artemis I onward.

## Mars Exploration

- [Viking & Mars](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/viking): the Viking program and the search for life on Mars.
- [Mars Pathfinder & Sojourner](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/bounce-mars-pathfinder): Mars Pathfinder, Sojourner, and the birth of the modern Mars rover.
- [The Spirit Rover](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/troy-spirit-rover): NASA's Spirit rover and the Mars Exploration Rover mission.
- [The Opportunity Rover](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/marathon-opportunity-rover): NASA's Opportunity rover and the Mars Exploration Rover mission.
- [The Curiosity Rover](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/skycrane-curiosity-rover): NASA's Curiosity rover and the Mars Science Laboratory mission.
- [The Perseverance Rover](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/jezero-perseverance-rover): NASA's Perseverance rover, the Ingenuity helicopter, and Mars Sample Return caching.

## Space Telescopes

- [Hubble & Space Telescopes](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/aperture-hubble-telescopes): the Hubble Space Telescope and the age of space observatories.
- [James Webb Space Telescope](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/james-webb-space-telescope): the James Webb Space Telescope, its deployment, and its discoveries.
- [Chandra X-ray Observatory](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/xray-chandra-observatory): NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory and its grazing-incidence optics.
- [Spitzer Space Telescope](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/infrared-spitzer-telescope): NASA's Spitzer Space Telescope, cryogenic infrared astronomy, and TRAPPIST-1.
- [Kepler Space Telescope](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/transit-kepler-telescope): NASA's Kepler Space Telescope and the transit method for finding exoplanets.
- [Gaia Mission](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/parallax-gaia-mission): ESA's Gaia mission and its billion-star map of the Milky Way.

## Human Spaceflight

- [Mercury & the First Astronauts](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/ascent-mercury-program): Project Mercury and the beginning of human spaceflight.
- [The Gemini Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/rendezvous-gemini-program): Project Gemini, the bridge between Mercury and Apollo.
- [Space Shuttle Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/orbiter-space-shuttle-program): NASA's Space Shuttle Program, its two disasters, and building the ISS.
- [Soyuz Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/union-soyuz-program): the Soyuz spacecraft, nearly sixty years of continuous crewed flight.
- [Commercial Crew Program](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/handoff-commercial-crew-program): NASA's Commercial Crew Program, Crew Dragon, and Starliner.

## Future Exploration

- [Artemis Base Camp](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/horizon-artemis-base-camp): NASA's Artemis Base Camp and the next era of lunar exploration.
- [The Lunar Gateway](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/the-lunar-gateway): NASA's Lunar Gateway station and its 2026 pause.
- [Mars Sample Return](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/retrieve-mars-sample-return): the campaign to bring Perseverance's sealed samples to Earth.
- [Europa Clipper](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/flyby-europa-clipper): NASA's Europa Clipper and the search for a habitable ocean moon.
- [Dragonfly Mission](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/rotor-dragonfly-titan): NASA's Dragonfly rotorcraft mission to Saturn's moon Titan.
- [Interstellar Probe Concept](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/beyond-interstellar-probe): a proposed, purpose-built successor to Voyager's interstellar mission.

## Foundations & Tools

- [Common Ground & Basic Logic](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/common-ground-basic-logic): binary, logic gates, if/then/else, binary addition and subtraction, and tracing a program from its inputs to its consequences.
- [Build Your Own CubeSat](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/build-your-own-cubesat): from Arduino basics and circuit fundamentals to the anatomy of a real CubeSat.
- [Lagrange Points](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/lagrange-points): the physics of Lagrange points and where they occur across the Solar System.
- [The Physics of Spaceflight](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/physics-of-spaceflight): the rocket equation, orbital mechanics, and a Δv map of the Solar System, ending with the engines from chemical rockets to fusion drives.

## Space & Time

- [Voyager / Heliosphere / Time](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/time-philosophy/): the Voyager trajectories, the heliosphere, and time as a structure rather than a line.
- [Time as Space](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/time-philosophy/time-as-space): a companion essay on modelling time spatially.
